site: Authors’ single campus shared space next to the roundabout, all eleven clips. Exclude all 17 crosswalk clips. No claim every point or image in the selected clips lacks painted road markings.
enrollment: On all eleven released clips, within each ID form maximal runs of consecutive source rows indexed from 1. Need same-ID history, ground-plane unfiltered tracked centres, source ratio, released image times and 30 future 10Hz-nearest index positions. Starting from the earliest t in a run, fix its first image as history start and use the nearest progressively dated real source frame to each nominal 0.1 s increment up to 3.4 s, with ties earlier. t0 equals fifth snapped frame. Require max absolute nominal grid deviation relative to t0 <= 0.050 s, monotone unique image IDs and all 35 source tracked observations; then advance beyond last used source frame. No interpolation of imagery, poses or source coordinates. Include zero-support clips. If raw recorded exposure times are unavailable, document container presentation times and separate from sensor-derived microsecond clocks. Do not call this strict 10Hz. One prespecified timing subset each for actual observed history differences <=1ms and endpoint <=1ms; report both denominators.
spatial: Source per-clip tracked XY/ratio in metres; y follows author image growing down unless separately validated. Source tracker point-centres may lie above ground in top view. Any transform to source full video follows official stabilised crop ROI; do not assume per-person bounding box.
pose_gate: Release contains same-ID tracked positions but no explicit per-person box columns. A model run requires either recoverable authoritative measured boxes or outcome-blind image-only person detections on each actual past image associated only to t0-or-earlier tracked points, with a prespecified geometry/one-to-one association/crop-quality policy. Before scoring first quantify the actual per-image mapping, sizes, chance of multiple competing IDs and ground/camera calibration. If these cannot be validated, leave this cohort a motion/occupancy/time-coverage analysis; do not invent per-person crop boxes or successful five-frame poses.
weights: If qualified: same four seed42 PINNS M0/M1 checkpoint pairs without adaptation plus both actual- and nominal-time last-pair CV. Top-probability forecast of six; average four frozen-checkpoint errors per window. Report by window, sequence-local person, and clip, and before outcome inspection lock primary axes. No deployment or cross-site inference from one overhead shared space. No new training and no local external forecast.
rights: Official public author GitHub and author-provided Google Drive video only. No clear repo grant to redistribute source images or tracks; private research download as the author offers, no raw redistribution. Kaggle private forward evaluation only if it can fetch original public author URLs without uploading or republishing source assets.
